sections.theory:
During exercise, through the contraction and expansion of the muscles, there is an increase in the quantity of white cells in the blood.

By doing exercise improvement comes in the power of resistance.

By doing exercise the performance of all the remaining systems of the body becomes better, through which the body becomes energetic and strong.
